walkthrough.title: In a complete tree, compare the leftmost and rightmost depths: when they match, that subtree is perfect and has 2^h − 1 nodes.

steps.text: Under 1 the left edge is 3 deep but the right edge only 2: count 1 itself and recurse into both children.
Under 2 the left and right edges are both 2 deep: a perfect subtree of 2^2 − 1 = 3 nodes. No need to look inside.
Under 3 the left edge is 2 deep but the right edge only 1: count 3 itself and recurse into both children.
Under 6 the left and right edges are both 1 deep: a perfect subtree of 2^1 − 1 = 1 nodes. No need to look inside.
